name: Shauchalaya Sahayata Yojana
briefDescription: The "Shauchalaya Sahayata Yojana" is a scheme by the government of Uttar Pradesh, India, to provide financial assistance to registered construction workers to build toilets in their homes.
benefitsMd:
- The scheme provides a grant of ₹12,000/- to eligible construction workers. 
- The money is paid in two installments: ₹6,000/- before the toilet is built and ₹6,000/- after the toilet is built and is in use
eligibilityMd:
1. Applicant must be registered with Uttar Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. Applicant must have their own homes, but not have toilets in it.
1. Applicant must not have received similar benefits from any other government scheme.
1. Applicant must be regularly depositing contributions.
1. Applicant must have an Aadhaar card.
1. Applicant must have a bank account in a CBS branch of a nationalized bank.
applicationMd:
1. District Panchayat Raj Officer provides list of registered construction workers.
1. Village Panchayat Secretary/Sanitation worker verifies list and prepares a list of toilet-less workers.
1. Labor department renews registrations of expired workers if needed.
1. Applications are obtained from eligible workers based on the prepared list.
1. Applicant can get the application from below sources: 

  - Nearest labor office.
  - Tehsildar of the concerned tehsil.
  - Block Development Officer of the concerned development block.
  - Download from [here](https://www.upbocw.in/pdf/adhisuchna/Shauchalay%20Sahayata%20Yojana.pdf). 
1. Get the application form and fill out the completely.
1. Attach required documents in the prescribed format.
1. Submit the application form in the same office.
